# `badge`

Helper: `badge(text, tone, { dot })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Badge` (`badge.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaPillButton` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Dot (6px, optional) and a status word in a pill.

## Variants

- Tone: neutral, brand, info, success, warning, danger

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

tile/ink-soft (neutral), brand-50/brand-700, and -soft/-line/text of each status; radius-pill, text-label

## Do

- The text is the status; colour only supports it

## Don't

- Do not use colour alone
- Do not use it as a button

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Padding 2/10.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Inline. Tones `neutral brand info success warning danger`; the text is always the status
